title: Prime Agent Artifacts carry strategic vision while Executor Agent Artifacts carry only operational rules
content:
The Agent Scope (A.6) regulates every Agent in the Sky Ecosystem, and each Agent is governed by its own Artifact rather than by a shared rulebook.

Two tiers are defined:

- **Prime Agent Artifacts** (A.6.1.1) are *collections* of documents defining each Agent's strategic vision **and** day-to-day operational logic.
- **Executor Agent Artifacts** (A.6.1.2) contain rules, processes, parameters and information relevant to the Agent — operational only, with no strategic mandate.

The asymmetry is the substance: Prime Agents are trusted to set direction, Executors to carry it out. The distinction is encoded in what their governing documents are permitted to contain, so it cannot be quietly eroded by an Executor accumulating strategic latitude without an Artifact amendment.
description: A.6.1.1 gives Prime Agents documents defining vision AND day-to-day logic; A.6.1.2 gives Executors rules, processes and parameters only — the asymmetry allocates authority to set direction.
